2609.07318.title: PLATOS: A Power and Latency-Aware Task-Oriented Scheduling Strategy for Healthcare IoT in Fog Computing
2609.07318.paper_summary: Healthcare Internet of Things (HIoT) technology is revolutionising the healthcare industry by enabling real-time data collection and analysis for personalised patient care. However, the rapid expansion of HIoT technology introduces challenges such as increased latency and higher energy consumption in fog computing environments, particularly when managing battery-operated devices. To address these issues, this work proposes a novel scheduling strategy that optimises both power consumption and latency through task-oriented scheduling for HIoT tasks. The proposed strategy, named PLATOS (Power and Latency Aware Task Oriented Scheduling), is implemented in four sequential phases. In the first phase, HIoT tasks are categorised into three groups: priority-oriented, storage-oriented, and computational-oriented. The second phase focuses on latency optimisation by identifying the fog computing resources that yield the lowest execution delay for each task category. In the third phase, power optimisation is achieved by selecting the resources that minimise energy consumption. Finally, in the decision-making phase, high-performance fog resources are allocated to high-priority tasks while the remaining tasks are scheduled based on a mapped list derived from the latency and power optimisation phases. Simulation experiments conducted in iFogSim2 demonstrate that PLATOS reduces energy consumption by 18.72% and latency by 8.65% when compared to the state-of-the-art. These improvements enhance the efficiency and responsiveness of HIoT systems and contribute to more effective patient care and proactive healthcare service delivery.
2609.07318.paper_summary_zh: 醫療物聯網 (HIoT) 技術正在徹底改變醫療行業，通過實現即時數據收集和分析來提供個性化的病人護理。<lb/>然而，HIoT 技術的快速擴展帶來了挑戰，例如在霧計算環境中增加的延遲和更高的能耗，特別是在管理電池供電的設備時。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，本研究提出了一種新穎的調度策略，通過面向任務的調度來優化 HIoT 任務的能耗和延遲。<lb/>所提出的策略名為 PLATOS（功率和延遲感知的任務導向調度），分為四個連續階段進行實施。<lb/>在第一階段，HIoT 任務被分為三個組別：優先級導向、存儲導向和計算導向。<lb/>第二階段專注於延遲優化，通過識別對每個任務類別產生最低執行延遲的霧計算資源來實現。<lb/>在第三階段，通過選擇最小化能耗的資源來實現功率優化。<lb/>最後，在決策階段，高性能的霧資源被分配給高優先級任務，而剩餘任務則根據從延遲和功率優化階段得出的映射列表進行調度。<lb/>在 iFogSim2 中進行的模擬實驗表明，與最先進技術相比，PLATOS 將能耗降低了 18.72%，延遲降低了 8.65%。<lb/>這些改進提高了 HIoT 系統的效率和響應能力，並促進了更有效的病人護理和主動的醫療服務交付。
